title: "Trait Bounds and Where Clauses"

# Trait Bounds and Where Clauses
Constrain generics using trait bounds and `where` clauses:

```rust
use std::fmt::Display;

fn print_and_return<T>(val: T) -> T
where
    T: Display + Clone,
{
    println!("Value: {}", val);
    val.clone()
}

fn main() {
    let res = print_and_return(42);
    println!("Returned: {}", res);
}
```
